summary: Refactored apps/agent-server/src/transport/websocket-server.ts into nine cohesive modules (websocket-server, websocket-connection, protocol-messages, request-message-handler, request-router, session-request-handler, resource-request-handler, project-request-handler, project-watch-coordinator) each under 300 LOC, keeping the createAgentWebSocketServer export path and API stable.
decisions: Split the single transport file into connection lifecycle (websocket-connection), protocol serialization/parsing (protocol-messages), request dispatch (request-router + request-message-handler), per-domain handlers (session/resource/project-request-handler), and project watch reuse (project-watch-coordinator), with websocket-server reduced to a thin server/origin-check coordinator.
Preserved the createAgentWebSocketServer public export from ./transport/websocket-server, so src/server.ts and src/index.ts import paths and signatures remain unchanged.
Tests in apps/agent-server/tests/transport were not modified or split because both existing files (244 LOC and 237 LOC) already stayed under the 300 LOC threshold and continued to pass.
